posts.preview: ANOTHER NON-COMPLIANCE ||  During a visit to Izzy Import and Export in Oshikango on Monday by the Parliamentary Standing Committee on Poverty Eradication, Labour and Industrial Relations, the company was found to be violating the labor laws.
The company was discovered paying its 60 workers N$12 per hour, way below the mandatory N$18 per hour minimum wage.
Committee Chairperson Hon. Justina Jona said the violation during the site visits shows a broader issue of employer non-compliance with fair wage regulations.
